import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter the data to get the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
df_top_breeds = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot for the top 10 dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
ax = sns.countplot(data=df_top_breeds, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette="viridis")
ax.set_title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)

# Add count annotations to each bar
for p in ax.patches:
    ax.annotate(f'{p.get_width()}', (p.get_width() + 100, p.get_y() + p.get_height() / 2), 
                ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12, color='black', xytext=(20, 0), 
                textcoords='offset points')

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
ax = sns.countplot(data=df_top_breeds, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette="viridis")
ax.set_title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
ax.set_ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)

# Add count annotations to each bar
for p in ax.patches:
    ax.annotate(f'{p.get_width()}', (p.get_width() + 100, p.get_y() + p.get_height() / 2),
